 Advertisement NorCal forecast: Drier, sunnier Sunday, but rain chances return Election Day
 Lingering Sierra rain and snow will taper early Sunday, with north winds helping clear skies across the region by afternoon.
 Advertisement Updated: 9:31 PM PDT Oct 31, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Ophelia Young Meteorologist NorCal forecast: Drier, sunnier Sunday, but rain chances return Election Day
 Lingering Sierra rain and snow will taper early Sunday, with north winds helping clear skies across the region by afternoon.
 Updated: 9:31 PM PDT Oct 31, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Ophelia Young Meteorologist Lingering Sierra rain and snow will taper early Sunday, with north winds helping clear skies across the region by afternoon. 
 Daylight Saving Time ends Sunday, which means our mornings will be brighter and our evenings will be darker. 
 Clouds bulk up again on Monday ahead of rain chances returning to the region during Election Day. 
 Advertisement Hearst Owned Sunday forecast
 Foothill showers will gradually diminish in the early morning hours, while snow lingers in the Sierra through Sunday morning. 
 The Valley will wake up dry with some cloud cover. 
 North winds will increase Sunday morning behind the departing Halloween weather system, bringing drier conditions and clearing skies by afternoon. 
 Hearst Owned Daylight Saving Time ends
 Daylight Saving Time ends Sunday, so remember to turn your clocks back one hour. Our new sunrise will be at 6:33 a.m., and sunset will be at 5:06 p.m. 
 Sunsets will continue getting earlier through early to mid-December, when the earliest sunset of the year will be at 4:44 p.m. 
 Hearst Owned Cloudy cool Monday
 The new work week will start cool and dry, though clouds return ahead of our next weather system.
 Advertisement Hearst Owned Election Day showers
 Tuesday now looks showery, with a line of rain and isolated thunderstorms potentially moving through the Valley around lunchtime. 
 Showers are expected to then spread east into the foothills, with isolated thunderstorms possible in the Sierra during the afternoon and evening. 
 Hearst Owned Foothills and Sierra 7 day forecast
 Breezy conditions are also expected in the Sierra on Tuesday. 
 The wet weather is expected to mainly affect the northern Sierra, foothills and valley. 
 Drier weather returns for the second half of the week. 
 Hearst Owned Valley 7 day forecast
 The rest of the week looks pleasant, with Valley highs recovering into the low 70s and a mix of sunshine and clouds continuing into next weekend.
